Alana (CS): Heads-up — Quokka Labs onboarding: we're seeing ~2x tail latency on the chat endpoint during peak. Customer reported intermittent slow replies. Anyone else seeing this?
Sam (ML Eng): Yup. KV cache miss rate is high in their traces. Their prompt distribution has lots of long system+context prefixes.
Diego (Platform): I can reproduce. CPU on the serving pool spikes when seq_len > ~120. Options: quantize to int8 for cost/throughput, or route long prefixes to a large-context model. Need to coordinate canary.
Rina (Solutions): Quick check — Quokka's product team said they can accept up to ~1% quality degradation for latency gains, but want a rollback plan.
Alana (CS): Proposed plan: 1) Canary deploy quantized variant (Q4-int8) at 10% traffic, fallback to current model. 2) Add prefix-based routing: requests with prefix_tokens > 120 -> large-context model; else -> quantized optimized model. 3) Enable prefix KV caching (TTL 12h) to reduce repeated decoding. Thoughts?
Diego (Platform): Sounds good. Drafted a routing snippet below we can push as a rule:
```json
{
  "policy": "prefix-routing",
  "rules": [
    {"match": {"prefix_tokens_gt": 120}, "route_to": "redwood-large-v2"},
    {"match": {"prefix_tokens_lte": 120}, "route_to": "redwood-opt-q4_0"}
  ],
  "canary": {"percent": 10, "model_override": "redwood-opt-q4_0-int8"}
}
```
Sam (ML Eng): I'll run a quick 50-prompt eval suite (customer-specific prompts) against the int8 canary and baseline and post delta metrics. Command I'll use: `runtest --customer quokka --model redwood-opt-q4_0-int8 --prompts ./evals/quokka.json`
Rina (Solutions): I'll schedule a 30-min sync to walk Quokka through expected regressions and rollback triggers. Alana — when are they available?
Alana (CS): They asked for Wed morning PT. Can we aim to start the canary Wed 10:00 PT after the quick evals?
ops-bot: Canary job queued: deploy-canary-33221 to 10% traffic on pool 'dedicated-quokka'. ETA ~15m.
Diego (Platform): I'll instrument canary with these alerts: latency > 200ms sustained for 2m OR quality delta > 2% -> auto rollback. Also adding soft-fallback to hosted-small if canary unstable.
Sam (ML Eng): Kicking off eval now, will post results in this thread in ~45m.
Alana (CS): thanks — please @mention me when metrics are in. I'll update the CSM runbook with the routing rule and rollback criteria.
Diego (Platform): I'll also add a temporary tracing tag `quokka-canary-2026` so we can filter traces easily.
Alana (CS): Great. If the canary looks good we'll extend to 50% next day and keep monitoring.
Sam (ML Eng): Posted eval summary: quality delta avg 0.6%, tail latency reduced ~35% on 10% traffic. Full CSV attached to the ticket.
Rina (Solutions): Thanks — I'll prep the customer-facing notes and the rollback steps.
Alana (CS): Moving to action items: @Sam run full 200-prompt check, @Diego deploy canary, @Rina run customer sync Wed 10am PT. I'll close the loop here once done. :thumbsup:
